recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-33268 unless the work group later chooses a different computable mechanism for topic inclusion guidance tied to subscription payload level.
issue_request: FHIR-33268 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-I R5 change request to make SubscriptionStatus.topic optional (0..1) because canonical SubscriptionTopic URLs can disclose PHI, and to add guidance that the topic SHOULD NOT be included for empty payloads, MAY be included for id-only payloads, and SHOULD be included for full-resource payloads.
initial_application: The Jira comment links commit cc31b9e89b0c81721faede7b4375631fc8377d73, which changed SubscriptionStatus.topic from min 1 to min 0, added the payload-level comment to the StructureDefinition, and added Content and PHI guidance to subscriptionstatus-notes.xml. Current blame attributes the preserved active lines to 17740f61cda26cd5836bee2905becfd196ab1e5c, the R4B/R5 subscription import.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively includes subscriptionstatus and subscriptiontopic in the current build. FHIR-I 2021-09-13 minutes corroborate the persuasive 6-0-0 FHIR-33268 vote and note that Subscription.id remains available when the topic is omitted. FHIR-27141 is background for the canonical topic design. FHIR-39037 later considered removing SubscriptionStatus.topic and resolved no-change because optionality already addresses the concern while keeping routing use cases. FHIR-39038 later added only locally enforceable SubscriptionStatus constraints and did not supersede the topic guidance.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The active StructureDefinition has SubscriptionStatus.topic as min 0, max 1, canonical(SubscriptionTopic), with the requested payload guidance comment, and the active notes include the PHI rationale plus per-notification table links to that guidance.

Later constraints issue added locally enforceable SubscriptionStatus invariants without changing topic optionality or PHI guidance.
